title: VillagerSociety
body:
🏙️ VillagerSociety

![VillagerSociety](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/876fbc154627e00017154801fb7e3fc61de0012f_0.webp)

Revolutionize Your SMP's Economy & Roleplay

Are you tired of players locking villagers in 1x1 cells? Sick of the "cure-spam" exploit ruining your economy? VillagerSociety transforms villagers from simple vending machines into living, breathing entities with needs, schedules, and standards.
Designed specifically for Survival Multiplayer (SMP) servers, this plugin adds depth, realism, and balance to villager interactions.

**✨ Key Features**

**🕒 Realistic Work Schedules**

![VillagerShift](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b00ade4fc95037b38a4b1a7f3cb25dbbf77c359_0.webp)

Villagers are no longer available 24/7. They now follow a configurable schedule (Default: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM).

- Players must visit during working hours to trade.
- Adds immersion and time-management gameplay.
- Configurable open/close times.

**🏠 Housing Standards (Anti-Trading Hall)**

Stop the abuse! Villagers will refuse to trade if their living conditions are poor.

- Space Requirements: Villagers check for open air blocks around them. No more 1x1 cells!
- Light Access: Villagers require access to light (sky or block light) to feel comfortable enough to trade.
- Encourages players to build actual villages and houses.

**🌑 The Night Market (Illegal Traders)**

When the sun goes down, the Night Market begins.

- Mysterious Spawns: A "Night Market Trader" (Wandering Trader) spawns randomly at night.
- Rare Loot: Configurable trades for rare items or high-level enchanted books.
- Risk vs. Reward: These traders are considered criminals! Iron Golems will actively hunt and attack them, adding dynamic events to your towns.
- Visuals: Traders can glow to be spotted in the dark.

**🧠 Zombie Trauma (Economy Fix)**

Fix the vanilla "Cure Exploit" without removing the mechanic entirely.

- Trauma System: If a player cures a villager too many times (configurable threshold), the villager suffers Trauma.
- Consequences: Instead of lowering prices, prices will skyrocket due to the stress of repeated zombification.
- Balances the economy by preventing infinite 1-emerald trades.

**📜 Trade Licenses**

Add RPG progression to your server.

- Optionally require players to hold a physical Trade License item in their inventory to interact with villagers.
- Great for roleplay servers or locking trading behind a quest/payment.
  
**⚙️ In-Game Admin GUI**

![AdminGui Settings](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88432a72bf20e01a5a86036547a65786095a46cd.png)
No need to dig through config files for simple changes.

- Run /vs settings to open a sleek GUI.
- Toggle modules (Housing, Night Market, Schedules, etc.) instantly.
Adjust work hours with a click.
- Disable specific professions (e.g., ban Librarians) easily.
  
**📸 Commands & Permissions**

Commands

- /vs settings - Open the Admin Configuration GUI.
- /vs getlicense - Spawns a Trade License item for the player.
- /vs spawnillegal - Force spawns a Night Market trader at your location.
- /vs reload - Reloads the configuration files.

Permissions

- villagersociety.admin - Access to the settings GUI.
- villagersociety.getlicense - Ability to spawn a license.
- villagersociety.spawnillegal - Ability to force spawn the illegal trader.
- villagersociety.reload - Ability to reload the plugin.
- villagersociety.bypass - Bypass work schedule restrictions.
- villagersociety.bypass.housing - Bypass housing requirements.

**📂 Configuration**

- VillagerSociety is highly configurable. You can tweak:
- Schedules: Set exact open and close times.
- Housing: Define how many air blocks are required.
- Trauma: Set the cure threshold and price multiplier.
- Night Market: Customize the items sold, prices, and currency (Emeralds, Diamonds, etc.).
- Messages: Full language file support for custom messages
